records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Net sales increased by 10% to $281,513,000 in the second quarter and by 21% to $600,003,000 for the six months ended March 26, 2022 compared to the three and six months ended March 27, 2021, respectively.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: The comparative performance was primarily a result of higher beverage sales volume which drove leverage across the business.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Net sales in our fiscal second quarter were negatively impacted by unexpected challenges related to our early February implementation of a new enterprise resource planning (“ERP”) system.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: The decreases in operating income were primarily attributable to higher cost of goods sold as well as the impacts related to our ERP implementation.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Compared to prior year, operating income in our Food Service segment decreased by 91% to $536,000 in the second quarter and by 22% to $9,537,000 in the six months reflecting the significant increase in ingredients, production and shipping costs as well as the impacts related to our ERP implementation.

records.title: 10-Q TRACTOR SUPPLY COMPANY
records.text: Net sales for the first quarter of fiscal 2022 increased 8.3% to $3.02 billion from $2.79 billion for the first quarter of fiscal 2021.

records.title: 10-Q TRACTOR SUPPLY COMPANY
records.text: Comparable store sales for the first quarter of fiscal 2022 were $2.94 billion, a 5.2% increase as compared to the first quarter of fiscal 2021.

records.title: 10-Q TRACTOR SUPPLY COMPANY
records.text: We usually experience our highest inventory and accounts payable balances during our first fiscal quarter for purchases of seasonal products to support the higher sales volume of the spring selling season, and again during our third fiscal quarter to support the higher sales volume of the cold weather selling season.

records.title: 10-Q TRACTOR SUPPLY COMPANY
records.text: As a percent of net sales, gross margin in the first quarter of fiscal 2022 decreased 29 basis points to 34.9% from 35.2%

records.title: 10-Q TRACTOR SUPPLY COMPANY
